docset:AgreementType.dg:chunk: BELET ENERGY INFRASTRUCTURE PARTNERS LP, as Borrower
docset:AgreementType.docset:LenderOrAgentEntityName: SOL SYSTEM ENERGY CONSORTIUM (SSEC), as Administrative Agent, Collateral Agent, and Lead Arranger

docset:AgreementType.docset:AgreementType: This SECURED TERM CREDIT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into on the Agreement Effective Date by and among the Borrower, the Lenders, and the Administrative Agent. In consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties hereto agree as follows:
docset:AgreementType.docset:FacilityName: WHEREAS, the Borrower owns and operates a comprehensive solar power grid utilizing organophotovoltaic surface collectors and deep-ground battery storage facilities located in the Belet Dunes region of Titan; and
docset:AgreementType.dg:chunk: WHEREAS, the Borrower has requested that the Lenders make loans to finance continuous solar array scaling, regular polymer substrate servicing, and active sandstorm-clearing maintenance; and the Lenders are willing to do so on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: midnightblue

docset:DefinedTerms.dg:chunk: As used in this Agreement, the following terms have the meanings specified below:

dg:chunk.docset:AgreementEffectiveDate: • "Agreement Effective Date" means the date on which this Agreement has been fully executed and delivered by all parties hereto, as verified by the date inscribed next to the signatures of the authorized officers in the execution block below (such date, the "Signature Date").
dg:chunk.dg:chunk: • "Belet Solar Grid Array" means the physical structural solar collectors, organophotovoltaic cells, dynamic electrostatic dust shielders, power conversion modules, and subsurface lithium-ion organometallic battery storage grids situated at Sector 21, Belet Dunes coordinates (latitude 4.8° S, longitude 12.4° W) on Titan, Saturn.
dg:chunk.docset:DefinedTerms: • "Helium-Pressurized Sinking Fund" or "HPSF" means the emergency cryogenic cooling and safety reserve fund mandated to be maintained under Section 4.01(3).
• "Regolith Stabilisation Escrow" means the cash escrow reserve fund mandated to be maintained under Section 4.01(4) to counter localized electrostatic sand shifts.

• "Solar Conversion Efficiency Index" or "SCEI" means the raw photovoltaic light-to-electricity conversion rating of the surface solar panels, adjusted for atmospheric aerosols, as certified by the Titan Technical Safety Directorate (TTSD).
dg:chunk.dg:chunk: • "Solar Power Tariff Target" means the minimum operational power production metric of 20,000 Megawatt-hours (MWh) equivalent delivered to the neighboring industrial domes per Titan sidereal cycle, as calculated under the provisions of Section 4.01(2) herein.
dg:chunk.docset:AccountingOrInterpretationRules: • "Sol System Interstellar Accounting Standards" or "SSIAS" means the unified framework of financial accounting principles approved by the Interstellar Financial Board.
dg:chunk.docset:BenchmarkReferenceRate: • "TIDOR" means the Titan Inter-Dome Offered Rate, which is the floating interbank benchmark rate calculated for Titan-denominated credit lines.

docset:AccountingOrInterpretationRules.docset:AccountingOrInterpretationRules: Capitalized terms defined in the singular shall have the corresponding meanings in the plural, and vice versa. Any references to specific sections, tables, or documents relate directly to this Agreement unless otherwise specified.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: midnightblue

docset:CreditFacilityCommitment.dg:chunk: ARTICLE II: THE SECURED CREDIT LINES

docset:CreditFacilityCommitment.docset:CreditFacilityCommitment: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, each Lender agrees to make a single advance term loan (each a "Facility Loan") to the Borrower on the Closing Date (which is identical to the Signature Date) in an aggregate principal amount of 6,500,000,000 Sol Credits (SC).

dg:chunk.dg:chunk: 1. The Facility Loans shall accrue interest daily at a floating rate per annum equal to TIDOR plus 6.75%.

2. Should the Solar Conversion Efficiency Index (SCEI) fall below 88.0% for any consecutive 3-day Titan cycle due to carbon-aerosol sky occlusion or electrostatic dust coating, the floating margin shall automatically increase by 3.00% per annum (the "Dynamic Siphon Charge Premium") until the SCEI is restored to 91.0% or above, as verified by the TTSD.

docset:RepaymentSchedule.docset:RepaymentSchedule: Repayment of the principal shall be executed in equal quarterly installments on the final operational day of each Martian fiscal quarter, starting on the first such date following the Agreement Effective Date, in accordance with the amortization schedules appended hereto.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: midnightblue

docset:RepresentationsAndWarranties.dg:chunk: The Borrower represents and warrants to the Lenders that:

docset:ExtractionOrOperatingRights.dg:chunk: The Borrower holds exclusive long-term leases to construct, operate, and maintain surface organophotovoltaic grids over the designated sand dune coordinates (Sector 21-Belet) under the authority of the Titan Regulatory Council (TRC).

docset:StructuralOrEnvironmentalToleranc.docset:StructuralOrEnvironmentalToleranc: The organophotovoltaic cells are equipped with high-voltage alternating-current electrostatic dust repulsion systems engineered to repel fine tholin aerosol deposits without causing structural degradation of the polymer substrate.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: midnightblue

docset:AffirmativeCovenants.dg:chunk: So long as any part of the Facility Loan remains outstanding, the Borrower shall:

dg:chunk.docset:MaintenanceCovenant: 1. Solar Grid Maintenance: Undertake continuous optical-spectroscopy and electrical audits of the active surface arrays to ensure the SCEI does not fall below the base standard of 89.0%.

2. Maintain Solar Power Tariff: Operate the distribution transformers and storage batteries to sustain the Solar Power Tariff Target of 20,000 MWh equivalent per Titan cycle, ensuring energy supply covenants with adjacent industrial domes are satisfied.
dg:chunk.docset:AffirmativeCovenants: 3. Helium Sinking Reserve: Maintain the cash-funded Helium-Pressurized Sinking Fund with the Administrative Agent, holding a balance of not less than SC 200,000,000 at all times to preserve battery terminal temperature limits.
4. Regolith Stabilisation Reserve: Maintain the cash-funded Regolith Stabilisation Escrow with the Administrative Agent, holding a balance of not less than SC 400,000,000 at all times.

docset:NegativeCovenants.dg:chunk: The Borrower shall not, without the explicit written approval of the Administrative Agent:

dg:chunk.docset:SystemModificationProhibition: 1. Array Expansions: Build secondary transmission grids or restructure high-voltage substations within the specified coordinates.
dg:chunk.docset:NegativeCovenants: 2. Restricted Payments: Declare or make any dividend distributions to corporate parent entities if the SCEI is below 90.0% or if a Default Event has occurred and is continuing.

dg:chunk.dg:style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: midnightblue

docset:DefaultArticle.dg:chunk: ARTICLE V: DEFAULT EVENTS AND REMEDIES

docset:EventOfDefault.dg:chunk: The occurrence of any of the following events shall constitute an Event of Default:

dg:chunk.dg:chunk: 1. Major Dust Obliteration: Any storm or electrostatic dune shift resulting in a loss of surface collector area exceeding 45% within any 48-hour cycle.
dg:chunk.docset:EventOfDefault: 2. Covenant Non-Compliance: Failure to maintain the required balances in the Helium-Pressurized Sinking Fund or the Regolith Stabilisation Escrow, or failure to meet the Solar Power Tariff Target for more than two consecutive quarters.
3. Battery System Runaway: Any unchecked localized heating of the subsurface organometallic batteries causing localized ice bedrock melting or regional thermal sink subsidence.
